info.title: xitter posts API
info.description: Posts, replies, and interactions (likes, bookmarks, reposts).

post.description: Create a post or reply. `text` is 1-512 chars; `mediaIds` (max 4) must exist, belong to the author and be ready (media internal lookup; non-ready ids 400 with details). Replies are rejected when a block exists between the replier and the parent author in either direction.

delete.description: Soft-delete own post (author only). Deleted posts are hidden everywhere.

get.description: Author's visible posts, newest first (replies included).
Replies to a post in chronological (oldest first) order.

post.description: Like, bookmark or repost a post. Idempotent on (kind, postId, userId). Rejected 403 when the caller is blocked by the post author (either direction). Reposting a repost reposts the original post - reposts are interactions, not posts, so chains cannot form; reposting your own post is allowed. Likes/reposts bump the post counts read-model and (for others’ posts) ping the author over the feed ws channel without creating feed entries.

delete.description: Remove the caller’s own interaction (idempotent 204). An undone repost removes its feed entries everywhere.

get.description: The caller's bookmarked posts, newest bookmark first. Private: only the caller's own bookmarks are ever listed. Soft-deleted posts drop out.

Batched viewer flags for list rendering: the caller's like/repost/bookmark state per post. `postIds` is a single comma-separated query param (1-100 uuids); ids with no interaction are returned with all flags false.

post.description: Bulk visible-post lookup (feed #7 hydration); deleted/missing ids are omitted from the response.
Truncate posts + interactions (reset job); deterministic reseed runs via the seed script.
